_comment: Merge these entries into your existing settings, do not replace them, and omit this property. The hq mod needs no entry here: Claude Code loads it from ~/.claude/mods/hq, where install.sh links it. enableWorkflows is needed for the saved workflows.

hooks.command: out=$("$HOME/.claude/bin/crew" ls --open 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$out" ] || printf 'Open crew tasks (see crew skill, section 9):\n%s\n' "$out"
